checks.name: runner: real touch taps are available (the probe is driven by tests/run_mobile_stage.mjs)
launch: phone mode is on (body.is-mobile, LB_isMobile(), a 390x844 touch screen)
launch: the empty state shows with its start button and no show is loaded
launch: a tap on the start button opens Quick Setup with the three example shows
modal: Quick Setup fits the phone and no control is cut off
open: the empty state has an Open-a-show-file control
open: a tap on the empty-state Open control raises the file picker and the chosen show loads (Town Hall: 2 destinations, 5 presets, 2 AUX)
open: a show file put into the app's own file input loads at phone size (Town Hall: 2 destinations, 5 presets, 2 AUX)
open: the Show card has an Open-a-show-file control
open: a tap on the Show-card Open control raises the file picker and the file replaces the open show
example Town Hall: opens from its dialog, the dialog fits the phone, and the preset list equals the model (codes, names, Dest / AUX / Outs / Layers)
example Town Hall: the visualiser fits its box on every preset (last destination inside .mb-vis, no sideways scrollbar)
example Town Hall: the accordion rows equal the model on every preset (destinations, D·L layers, AUX / DSM content)
example Town Hall: every chip size in the visualiser equals getLayerSize x destination size
example Awards Night: opens from its dialog, the dialog fits the phone, and the preset list equals the model (codes, names, Dest / AUX / Outs / Layers)
example Awards Night: the visualiser fits its box on every preset (last destination inside .mb-vis, no sideways scrollbar)
example Awards Night: the accordion rows equal the model on every preset (destinations, D·L layers, AUX / DSM content)
example Awards Night: every chip size in the visualiser equals getLayerSize x destination size
example General Session: opens from its dialog, the dialog fits the phone, and the preset list equals the model (codes, names, Dest / AUX / Outs / Layers)
example General Session: the visualiser fits its box on every preset (last destination inside .mb-vis, no sideways scrollbar)
example General Session: the accordion rows equal the model on every preset (destinations, D·L layers, AUX / DSM content)
example General Session: every chip size in the visualiser equals getLayerSize x destination size
edit: a tap on a preset's pencil opens it with Back, the visualiser and the Destinations / Layers / AUX rows
edit: a tap on a wall in the visualiser opens its destination row with the docked Destination panel
edit: a double tap on a wall never pops a floating desktop panel
edit: a tap on a layer chip in the visualiser opens its layer row with the docked Layer panel (Simple)
layer: Size 960 x 540 + APPLY updates the model and the docked panel stays open
layer: after APPLY the visualiser shows the new size while the panel is still open (chip reads 960x540)
layer: the docked panel header never covers the visualiser while the page scrolls
layer: a content pick in the docked panel writes through to the model, the layer row and the visualiser
add: + DEST adds a destination to the model, the accordion and the visualiser
visualiser: still fits its box after + DEST (four walls)
remove: − DEST asks to confirm, Cancel keeps the destination, Remove deletes it from every preset
add: + AUX adds an output that is on in every preset and drawn in the visualiser
aux: a tap on an AUX row docks the AUX panel in the row
remove: − AUX asks to confirm, Cancel keeps the AUX, Remove deletes it
back: Back returns to the list from a docked Destination, Layer and AUX panel, no panel flag is stranded and the next preset opens
add: + New Preset adds one preset and its card
Wire portrait: a tap on Wire shows the rotate card over the tool, and the tool pill still works
Wire landscape: the rotate card is gone and the diagram draws in Simple, fitted, with no Advanced tabs
Wire: a show saved in Advanced is shown in Simple on the phone (no Advanced tiles or tabs on screen)
Wire: opening Wire on the phone does NOT change the saved view of a show saved in Advanced (wireSettings.wireView stays "advanced" for Save, Send and the autosave)
I/O: a tap on I/O Patch shows one card per source, destination, AUX and multiviewer, equal to the model
I/O: a connector picked on a source card is stored and shown, and the menu fits the phone
I/O: a resolution picked from the side sheet is stored and shown, and the sheet fits the phone
I/O: a source renamed on its card (typed, then a tap away) is renamed in every preset
exports: the Excel cue sheet runs at phone size (the Pre-Export Check fits and Export Anyway delivers the .xlsx)
exports: the I/O Excel runs at phone size
exports: the Look Book builds a cover and one page per preset at phone size, from a window that fits the phone
exports: the Wire drawing builds at phone size, and the Wire export window fits the phone
modal: Help fits the phone
modal: every Help tab can be reached on the phone, and a tap on the last one opens it
modal: Quick Setup opened from the Show card fits the phone
landscape: phone mode stays on after the phone is rotated and the preset list still equals the model
landscape: the visualiser fits its box on every preset of General Session
landscape: a layer row docks its panel and Back still works
landscape: I/O Patch cards equal the model count
panels: no floating desktop panel appeared on the phone at any point (every Destination / Layer / AUX panel carried .mb-inline-panel)
portrait: the page never scrolls sideways on any screen
landscape: the page never scrolls sideways on any screen
no page errors during the phone run (exceptions, console.error, native dialogs)
